{{Quote|The Alliance moon-racer is always on hi alert - ready to streak off to any bleak part of the galaxy!|[[Return of the Jedi Weekly 61|''Return of the Jedi Weekly'' 61]]|<ref name="Return of the Jedi Weekly 61">[[Return of the Jedi Weekly 61|''Return of the Jedi Weekly'' 61]]</ref>}}
A '''Moonspeeder''' was a small [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] spacecraft. It bore a resemblance to the [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeder]].

==Behind the scenes==
This craft was introduced in a feature called ''Build the Moonspeeder'', which could be cut out of the comic book and folded into a paper model.
